questions.stem_text: Weber (1919) said that the state's monopoly of the use of force was legitimated by:
Society cannot be studied in the same way as the natural world because:

options.A: human behaviour is meaningful, and varies between individuals and cultures
options.B: it is difficult for sociologists to gain access to a research laboratory
options.C: sociologists are not rational or critical enough in their approach
options.D: we cannot collect empirical data about social life

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - human behaviour is meaningful, and varies between individuals and cultures

questions.stem_text: Parsons argued that the two main functions of the modern family were:

options.D: oppressing women and reproducing the labour force

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - primary socialization and personality stabilization

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following statements most closely corresponds with differential association
theory?

options.A: If all of your friends jumped off a bridge, I suppose you would too.
options.B: You should be proud to be a part of this organization.
options.C: If the door is closed, try the window.
options.D: Once a thief, always a thief.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - If all of your friends jumped off a bridge, I suppose you would too.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following is not a characteristic of totalitarian societies?
